topic.title: Would you outsource being an adult?
topic.context: AI agents can help with shopping, bookings and business phone calls. Google announced agentic shopping and store calling on November 13, 2025, and booking assistance for restaurants, event tickets and appointments on November 17, 2025. Availability varies by market and service; these are established examples, not news announced today. What will humans actually do with the time saved?
topic.opening: AI agents can make your phone calls and do your shopping. We call it the future. It sounds like adults buying a replacement adult. What are you outsourcing first?

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: AI agents can make your phone calls and do your shopping. We call it the future. It sounds like adults buying a replacement adult. What are you outsourcing first?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: If an AI handles all my errands, I finally get my afternoons back.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Afternoons back? So you're outsourcing your entire afternoon? What's next, a robot to hug your plants while you nap?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: I could use those hours for… เอ่อ… ทำสิ่งที่มีประโยชน์กว่า

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Oh. We've lost you to Thailand. Come back, we need English. What's the useful thing you'd do with those hours?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Oh shut up, you know what I mean!

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Alright, alright, I'll stop. So, what's the useful thing you'd do with those hours?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: I can spend time for more important things.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Spend time FOR? You survived AI replacing humanity just to be murdered by a preposition. Say 'spend time ON.' Try again.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: I can spend time on more important things.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: There we go. Now you sound like an actual adult. What's the first important thing on your list?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Honestly? Binge Netflix without checking my work messages.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Ah, the classic "I'll be productive by doing absolutely nothing" strategy. Netflix is just your new boss, right?
